context.transcript:
We've chosen an advertising firm to promote the new Colossus tractor we're making.
Several of the firm's representatives will be visiting next week, and I've planned for you to give them a tour of the assembly line on Tuesday.
Is that okay?
Well, I'm having some of our production equipment serviced right now, so they wouldn't be able to see the assembly line in full operation.
The next day, Wednesday, would be better for the tour.
Okay, the advertising reps are planning to leave Wednesday evening, but I think we should be able to squeeze in a tour during the morning.
I'll give them a call right now to make sure this time change is okay.
context.transcript_translation:
我们选择了一家广告公司来推广我们正在制造的新 Colossus 拖拉机。
该公司的几位代表下周会来拜访，我计划你周二带他们参观装配线。
可以吗？
嗯，我们目前的一些生产设备正在进行保养，所以他们无法看到完全运行的装配线。
后天，周三，进行参观会更好。
好的，广告代表们计划周三晚上离开，但我认为我们应该能在上午挤出时间进行参观。
我现在给他们打电话确认一下这个时间更改是否可以。
